bio.text: Everett Wess is the Democratic nominee for the open U.S. Senate seat in Alabama in 2026, running against Republican nominee Rep. Barry Moore.

He has been managing partner of The Wess Law Firm, P.C. in Birmingham since 2001, practicing mainly estate planning and criminal defense, and served on the Federal Criminal Justice Act panel for ten years.
He has been a Midfield municipal court judge and earlier served as a prosecutor for Midfield and a public defender for Irondale.

According to his campaign website, he holds a law degree from the Birmingham School of Law, an MBA and a computer science degree from Alabama A&M University, and an associate degree from Selma University.
